summary: RptDestProfileSummary is a web user control for generating destination profile summary reports within the HSPnet application. It manages report creation workflows, user access, and error handling for destination-based report generation. The control ensures proper validation of user actions, destination selection, and system limits before invoking the report generation process.
purpose: To allow authorized users to generate destination profile summary reports, validating access, destination selection, and handling exceptions such as exceeding maximum reportable items and insufficient selections.

workflows.name: Generate Destination Profile Summary Report
steps: System checks if the user session is in 'SwitchUserViewOnly' mode; if so, disables report generation.
System retrieves destination access list for the user.
If no destinations are selected, system displays an error message prompting at least one destination selection.
If destination count exceeds MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS, system displays an error message with support contact information.
If valid destination list is selected, system concatenates DestinationCodeID values into a string.
System calls PrintJobs.ReportDestinationProfileCreateJob with user session and destination codes to generate the report.

business_rules: Users must select at least one destination to generate a report.
Report generation is not permitted when monitoring a user via local admin switched view.
Maximum number of included destinations is enforced by PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
validations: Check if user is in SwitchUserViewOnly mode; if true, disable report generation.
Verify destination access list is non-empty.
Validate destination count does not exceed MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
DestinationCodeID values are correctly concatenated for report generation.
calculations: Concatenate DestinationCodeID values into a comma-separated string.
Strip trailing comma from the destination code string.
conditions: UserSession.SwitchUserViewOnly is true: report generation disabled.
Destination access list count is zero: error displayed.
Destination access list count >= MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS: error and support prompt displayed.
Destination access list count > 0 and < MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS: proceed to report generation.
system_behavior: Disables report button for admin monitoring another user.
Adds error messages to user session for invalid or excessive destination selection.
Generates report job when conditions are valid.
exceptions: No destination selected: user prompted to select at least one.
Destination count exceeds MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS: user prompted to contact support.
Switched user view: report functionality hidden.
content_gaps: No detailed field definitions for Destination entity.
No information on report output structure or its contents.
Workflow step details for handling asynchronous report job completion, user notification, or error recovery not provided.
